一路上没停，等下高速的时候，余振东的车子已经在高速路口等着了。

这时候已经下午三点左右了，余振东就算再着急，也要安排吴姜他们先将午饭吃了。

吴姜和王寻吃的都很满意，知道余振东心急，吃饱也没逗留，直接往普安寺去了。

普安寺位于云市的城郊，依山而建，环境清幽，处处透着一股古朴肃穆的气息。

听余振东介绍，平时这里的香火还算旺盛，但或许是因为厉鬼作祟的缘故，寺庙现在大门紧闭，看不到香客的身影。

余振东上前敲响了寺庙的大门，不一会儿，就有一个和尚过来开门了。

余振东先是客气的和开门的和尚打了声招呼，这才带着吴姜两人走进寺庙。

穿过前殿，来到后院的一间禅房里，吴姜看到了余振东的家人。

除了余振东的老婆之外，还一个面色苍白、身形单薄的年轻男人，应该就是余安安了。

另外还有一个十来岁的小姑娘，眼神怯生生的，应该就是的妹妹余乐乐。

一家人脸色都十分憔悴，眼窝深陷，眼底布满了红血丝，显然是这几天没休息好。

王寻一见到余安安，两个难兄难弟就狠狠地拥抱了在了一起。

余振东则是在一旁，一一给吴姜介绍自己的家人。

余夫人连连朝着吴姜鞠躬，感谢吴姜过来帮忙。

王寻更是拉着余安安，替吴姜吹嘘道：“安妹，这就是我姜哥，他可厉害了，我爸请了那么所谓的大师，都对付不了缠着我的女鬼，结果我姜哥出马，三下五除二的就解决了！”

余安安因为名字起的有些偏女性化，外加长相清秀，刚上大学，就荣获了“安妹”的外号。

此刻听到王寻的话，都恨不得立马给吴姜磕一个。

他现在都快内疚死了，因为他的缘故，让全家跟着他一起担惊受怕，尤其是妹妹，即使住进了寺庙里，晚上睡觉都会吓醒好几回。

吴姜笑着拍了一下王寻，无奈道：“别听这个小子瞎吹，我还没厉害到那个程度。”

王寻不服气的说道：“哪有，姜哥你出马，一定没问题！”

吴姜没理他，转头向余振东一家人询问了一些细节，随后便让余振东领他去见一下寺庙里的主事人。

随后，余振东领着吴姜，去见了普安寺的新主持，方明大师。

方明大师是方静大师的师弟，约莫四十多岁，穿着一身灰色僧袍，面容温和。

方明大师见到吴姜这么年轻，眼中虽有一丝惊讶，但脸上却没有丝毫轻视之意。

他心里清楚，能被余振东当成救命稻草请来的人，必定是个有真本事的。

连忙起身，双手合十行了个佛礼：“阿弥陀佛！”

吴姜也客气的回了一礼，这才开口询问那个厉鬼的情况。

方明大师轻轻叹了口气，说道：“说来惭愧，我们寺院，真正有修行在身的，只有方静师兄一人，剩下的师弟们，包括我在内，修行都没有入门，这才导致今日的祸事。”

“方静师兄那天镇压厉鬼后，已是深受重伤，后来将厉鬼镇压在佛像前，我们师兄弟日夜诵经，想将厉鬼超度，奈何师兄伤势恶化，突然圆寂，厉鬼这才得以冲出封印。”

“我等无能，没能拦住厉鬼，要不是寺庙里佛法气息庄严，恐怕我们师兄弟，也早已遭了厉鬼的毒手。”

余振东站在一旁，羞愧得不敢抬头，毕竟厉鬼是因为他儿子买的玉佩引来的，连累了方静大师，也连累了普安寺的众僧。

吴姜也为那位素未谋面的方静大师感到惋惜，先不论对方的实力如何，此番品行，对得起大师的称呼了。

They didn't stop along the way. When they got off the expressway, Yu Zhendong's car was already waiting at the intersection.

It was already around three o'clock in the afternoon. Even if Yu Zhendong was in a hurry, he still had to arrange for Wu Jiang and the others to have lunch first.

Wu Jiang and Wang Xun were very satisfied with their food. Knowing that Yu Zhendong was impatient, they didn't stay until they were full and went directly to Pu'an Temple.

Pu'an Temple is located on the outskirts of Yun City. It is built on the mountain. It has a quiet environment and a simple and solemn atmosphere everywhere.

According to Yu Zhendong, the incense here is usually quite strong, but perhaps because of the evil spirits, the temple is now closed and no pilgrims can be seen.

Yu Zhendong stepped forward and knocked on the door of the temple. After a while, a monk came and opened the door.

Yu Zhendong first greeted the monk who opened the door politely, and then led Wu Jiang into the temple.

After passing through the front hall and coming to a Zen room in the backyard, Wu Jiang saw Yu Zhendong's family.

In addition to Yu Zhendong's wife, there is also a pale and thin young man, who should be Yu An'an.

There is also a teenage girl with timid eyes, who must be my younger sister Yu Lele.

The whole family looked very haggard, with sunken eye sockets and red bloodshot eyes. It was obvious that they had not had a good rest in the past few days.

As soon as Wang Xun saw Yu Anan, the two brothers and sisters hugged each other fiercely.

Yu Zhendong was on the side, introducing his family members to Wu Jiang one by one.

Mrs. Yu bowed to Wu Jiang repeatedly and thanked Wu Jiang for coming to help.

Wang Xun even pulled Yu Anan and boasted for Wu Jiang: "Mei An, this is my brother Jiang. He is very powerful. My father hired so-called masters, but they couldn't deal with the female ghost that pestered me. But in the end, I, brother Jiang, took action and solved it with three strikes, five strikes and five divided by two!"

Yu Anan was nicknamed "Mei An" when she first entered college because of her somewhat feminine name and her pretty appearance.

When I heard Wang Xun's words at this moment, I wanted to give Wu Jiang a kiss immediately.

He felt so guilty now that because of him, the whole family was frightened along with him, especially his sister, who would wake up several times at night even if she lived in a temple.

Wu Jiang smiled, patted Wang Xun, and said helplessly: "Don't listen to this kid's nonsense, I'm not that good yet."

Wang Xun said unconvinced: "No way, Brother Jiang, if you take action, there will be no problem!"

Wu Jiang ignored him, turned to ask Yu Zhendong's family for some details, and then asked Yu Zhendong to take him to meet the person in charge of the temple.

Later, Yu Zhendong led Wu Jiang to meet the new abbot of Pu'an Temple, Master Fang Ming.

Master Fang Ming is the junior disciple of Master Fang Jing. He is about forty years old. He wears a gray monk's robe and has a gentle face.

Master Fang Ming had a hint of surprise in his eyes when he saw Wu Jiang was so young, but there was no sign of contempt on his face.

He knew in his heart that the person who could be hired by Yu Zhendong as a life-saving straw must be someone with real abilities.

He quickly stood up, put his hands together and performed a Buddhist salute: "Amitabha!"

Wu Jiang also returned the courtesy politely, and then asked about the situation of the fierce ghost.

Master Fang Ming sighed softly and said: "It's a shame to say that in our temple, only senior brother Fang Jing is really practicing. The rest of the brothers, including me, have not started practicing. This is what led to today's disaster."

"Senior brother Fang Jing was seriously injured after suppressing the ghost that day. Later, he suppressed the ghost in front of the Buddha statue. We brothers chanted sutras day and night to save the ghost. However, senior brother's injury worsened and he suddenly passed away. Only then did the ghost break out of the seal."

"We were incompetent and failed to stop the evil ghost. If it weren't for the solemn Buddhist aura in the temple, I'm afraid our brothers and sisters would have been poisoned by the evil spirit."

Yu Zhendong stood aside, too ashamed to raise his head. After all, the evil ghost was attracted by the jade pendant his son bought, which caused Master Fang Jing and the monks of Pu'an Temple to suffer.

Wu Jiang also felt sorry for Master Fang Jing, whom he had never met before. Regardless of his strength, his conduct was worthy of the title of master.
